_comment: Sheet layout per character. cell width and pivot x are computed by `npm run art-spec` from the hitboxes (furthest reach + 8 px in front of the pivot, 40 px behind, rounded up to a multiple of 8); cell height and pivot y are set here. The dummy reuses Rook's sheet with a grey palette shift.

corvane.color: iron grey (skin and wrist bands), rust-brown leather (secondary)
